## Limitations (read before citing any number)

- Tiny, synthetic, author-written corpus (4 short policies) and author-written cases: results are a regression/smoke benchmark, NOT evidence about real insurance documents or real users.
- Cases are scoped to one document, so each ranker orders only 9-17 chunks; high Recall@5 is easy here and will not transfer to large corpora.
- Small n per category: differences of one case are large percentage swings. No significance tests.
- Paraphrase and cross-lingual cases were written knowing the corpus; they may be easier or harder than real claim narratives.
- RRF parameters (k=60, depth=20) are defaults, not tuned; no tuning was done on these cases.
- Latency is CPU-only, single process, warm model, on one developer machine.
- Unanswerable queries show scores only; no abstention threshold is derived or validated yet.
